Turnkey · Indore

ATHA

A restaurant in Indore with hand-sculpted cave walls, soft cream tones and an open-air garden under a thatched roof.

Location
Indore
Venue
Restaurant
Scope
Turnkey: design & execution
Spaces
Dining rooms & garden
The project

Shaped by hand, softened by light.

Inside, the walls are sculpted into organic, cave-like forms, with recessed niches and arches that make the dining room feel carved rather than built.

Warm timber chairs, orange cushions and a striking blue sculpture punctuate the calm cream palette, while the garden outside trades plaster for thatch, sand and planting.

Inside ATHA

Space by space

The sculpted dining room

Long tables sit beneath flowing plaster walls with built-in niches displaying pottery and objects.

The arch

A softly rounded opening frames a raised dining area, its curves lit from within.

The signature wall

The ATHA name glows against sculpted relief, beside a bold blue face sculpture that has become the room's calling card.

The garden

Outdoors, a thatched canopy, sand floor, rattan seating and palms create a relaxed, open-air setting.
